extractedText: CallboardJuly 2026NJ INTO THE WOODS, Off Broad Street Players, 07/13/2026 & 07/14/2026 by Patricia Bradford June 30, 2026 45 Show: INTO THE WOODS Theater: Off Broad Street Players Theater Website: https://www.obsp.org/auditions Theater Phone: (856) 358-2688 Start date of auditions: 07/13/2026 Auditions INTO THE WOODS Book by James Lapine, Music and Lyrics by Stephen Sondheim Directed by Walter A. Webster Audition Dates/Times: Monday, July 13th 6:30 – 9:00 PM Tuesday, July 14th 6:30 – 9:00 PM Audition will consist of 32 bars of music that best shows your vocal range. LOCATION: Hopeloft, 40 E Commerce St, Bridgeton, NJ 08302 Audition videos may be submitted digitally to walterwebster58@gmail.com SIGN UP LINK Performances: September 18, 19, 20, 25, 26 and 27 Character Descriptions All roles are open and seeking a multi diverse cast from ages 15 and up. ALL are welcome to auditions. The Narrator A librarian who discovers a hidden book and eventually loses his/her self in the story. Educated, Engaging, Expendable Gender: Male or Female | Age: 18 to 64 Vocal Range: G2 to E4 The Witch After losing her mother’s magic beans, she is cursed with “ugliness”. She believes that if she can reverse this curse she will be able to secure a lasting life with a child she has kidnapped and kept in a tower. Through her journey, she comes to realize that her wish will not bring her the happiness that she has longed for and decides to take fate in her own hands. Twisted, Torn, Triadic Gender: Female | Age: 35 to 55 Vocal Range: F3 to G5 The Baker This man is scared by past abandonment and is just trying to get by in life. Because of the lack of a male’s influence, he can’t grasp the reality of being a man, a husband, or a father. As we progress through the show, he learns life is messy and no one is truly alone. Innocent, Idealist, Ignorant Gender: Male | Age: 25 to 45 Vocal Range: A Flat 2 to G4 Rapunzel’s Prince After having to live in his brother’s shadow for so long, this handsome young lad sets out to seek his own adventures. Upon falling in love with a dreamlike maiden, he is pierced with the realities of life. Will he pursue a family life or try to find happiness elsewhere? Attractive, Adoring, Annoyed Gender: Male | Age: 17 to 40 Vocal Range: C Sharp 3 to E4 Mysterious Old Man Is he a beggar or a hermit or father to half of our characters? We know at least he is the father of the Baker and Rapunzel. This man is either on the run from responsibilities or can’t stand to face the guilt he has to live with from all the pain he has caused. You decide. Wacky, Weathered, Withdrawn Gender: Male | Age: 50 to 65 Vocal Range: G2 to E Flat 4 Steward (Ensemble) A man servant who is used to doing whatever he has to solve a problem. His only care is to please his master or the strongest personality in the room. Conniving, Callous, Coward Gender: Male | Age: 30 to 50 The Baker’s Wife A mid-western house wife type desperately seeking for her life to be different. I’m not sure if she knows what she wants. Her wishes vary between children to a more glamorous life of royalty. Desperate, Determined, Dreamer Gender: Female | Age: 25 to 45 Vocal Range: F3 to G5 Cinderella She too wishes her life were different. However upon getting her wish, she realizes it’s not what she thought it would be. How can she find middle ground in an ever changing world? Hopeful, Honorable, Hesitant Gender: Female | Age: 16 to 30 Vocal Range: G3 to G5 Cinderella’s Prince Men and Women all want to either be or be with him and he knows it. This playboy is use to all the accolades without deserving one of them. Life for him is deciding which maiden to seduce next. Self-centered, Shallow, Shame-less Gender: Male | Age: 20 to 40 Vocal Range: B2 to F4 Red Riding Hood Coming from a life of privilege, this little one must learn to be more cautious. Her carefree lifestyle comes in contact with dangers beyond her imagination. How she deals with these situations will force her to take a good look at herself and everything she thinks she knows. Careless, Caught, Challenged Gender: Female | Age: 15 to 20 Vocal Range: B flat 3 to F5 Cinderella’s Step-Mother Gender: Female or Male | Age: 40 to 60 Vocal Range: A3 to F Sharp 5 Lucinda, Florinda (Step-Sisters) Gender: Female | Age: 16 to 40 Vocal Range: C4 to A Flat 5 These three women are always pursuing a glamorous lifestyle to save them from their current situation. They wear the best that they have in order to mask their poverty. They are like vultures in that they find joy feeding off others. Fake, Frustrated, Flighty Granny (Ensemble) This is a woman who has been calloused by life. The fire in her eyes is only out shined by the love in her heart for her granddaughter. Feisty, Fearless, Fierce Gender: Female | Age: 40 to 65 Jack Feeling he has no friends in the world, he finds solace in the family’s cow.
